_about: Settings for the GPS terrain/building export (see INTEGRATION_PLAN.md, 'Chosen approach for buildings'). Distances and errors are in yards.

shapeError._about: Max height error when simplifying each tile's height map into triangles. 1 yard is the agreed starting point (2026-10-13): 0.5 looks the same close up, 2 gets faceted walls close up.

bakeIntoHeights._about: Trees and other M2 doodads are not baked: canopies turn forests into lumpy hills. They stay painted on the minimap or are placed as ModelScene models near the camera.

modelOverrides._about: Per-model fine-tuning, keyed by WMO FileDataID. shapeError overrides the default for triangles belonging to that model; exclude: true leaves it out of the height map.
